headline: Foreign Funds Flee Rp 505,6 Billion in Session I, 10 Stocks Heavily Sold
summary: The IHSG weakened 0.87% to 5,297.83 in the first session, with foreign investors recording net sales of Rp505.6 billion. Ten top shares were sold.
why: Foreign net flows are a key gauge of international investor appetite for Indonesian equities, and they can influence the rupiah.
why_moved: Foreign investors recorded net selling of Rp505.6 billion during the session, according to the input.
original_headline: Dana Asing Lari Rp 505,6 Miliar di Sesi I, 10 Saham Ini Banyak Dilepas
